name: player-walker
js: (async () => { const C = window.CITY, a = C.worldFromLatLon(43.6562, -79.3806); const r = C.nearestRoads(a.x, a.z, 80)[0]; const nx = -r.dz, nz = r.dx, off = r.road.w / 2 + 2.5; window.__CITY_APP.teleportTo(r.px + nx * off, r.pz + nz * off, Math.atan2(r.dx, r.dz)); await __pcSleep(9000); const pw = await __pcPlayerAtWalker(90000, 6); await __pcSleep(1500); __pcLogStart(); return pw; })()

name: player-cluster
js: (async () => { __pcRelease(); const C = window.CITY, a = C.worldFromLatLon(43.6562, -79.3806); const r = C.nearestRoads(a.x, a.z, 80)[0]; const nx = -r.dz, nz = r.dx, off = r.road.w / 2 + 2.5; window.__CITY_APP.teleportTo(r.px + nx * off, r.pz + nz * off, Math.atan2(r.dx, r.dz)); await __pcSleep(5000); const f = await __pcFind(5, 150000, 14); const pg = __pcPlayerAtGroup(5.5); await __pcSleep(1800); __pcLogStart(); return { f, pg }; })()
